title: FY 2082/83 third-quarter financial report published
description: UTKHPL published its third-quarter financial report, providing a current company disclosure for operating and financial monitoring.
source_title: Upper Tamakoshi Hydropower Limited project updates

title: FY 2079/80 and 2080/81 annual reports published
description: UTKHPL published its sixteenth and seventeenth annual reports covering the two fiscal years.
source_title: Upper Tamakoshi Hydropower Limited annual reports

title: SJVN management reviewed project progress
description: SJVN recorded a management review of Arun-3; the event confirms active construction but does not by itself establish a comparable physical-progress percentage.
source_title: SJVN press releases

title: Current ownership and early-stage status recorded
description: ICRA recorded the proposed ownership split among GMR, SJVN, IREDA and NEA and described the project as being at a very early stage of development.
source_title: ICRA rating rationale for GMR Energy Limited

title: Ninth Panel of Experts report disclosed
description: ADB disclosed the ninth environmental and social Panel of Experts report for the active Tanahu project.
source_title: ADB Tanahu Hydropower Project documents

title: FY 2024/25 audited project financial statements disclosed
description: ADB disclosed audited project financial statements for 16 July 2024 to 16 July 2025.
source_title: ADB Tanahu Hydropower Project documents

title: Letter of intent published
description: BGJCL published a current letter-of-intent notice, demonstrating active procurement activity without establishing construction commencement.
source_title: BGJCL notices

title: AIIB proposed-project summary disclosed
description: AIIB listed Dudhkoshi as proposed, Category A, with USD 200 million of proposed sovereign financing and ADB as lead co-financier.
source_title: AIIB Dudhkoshi project summary

title: Development teaser issued for market sounding
description: DKJVCL issued a market-sounding teaser for the current 600 MW main powerhouse plus 70 MW dam-toe design basis.
source_title: Dudhkoshi development teaser

title: Draft final DPR submitted
description: India's Ministry of Jal Shakti records that WAPCOS submitted the draft final DPR in November 2016; a mutually acceptable final DPR remains unresolved.
source_title: Ministry of Jal Shakti Pancheshwar project page

title: Re-regulating dam application visible in DoED register
description: DoED's current application register includes a separate 271.5 MW Mugu Karnali Re-regulating Dam Hydropower Project promoted by VUCL.
source_title: DoED hydro survey-licence application register

title: Dhalkebar-Inaruwa segment entered operation
description: The eastern Dhalkebar-Inaruwa segment is treated as operational while the Hetauda-Dhalkebar segment remains under construction.
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2024/25

title: Cross-border line groundbreaking held
description: The governments of India and Nepal jointly carried out the groundbreaking of the 400 kV Gorakhpur-Butwal transmission line.
source_title: Embassy of India bilateral visit record

title: POWERGRID reported the implementing joint venture
description: POWERGRID reported that the Indian portion is implemented through a 50:50 joint venture with NEA and recorded paid-up capital at 31 March 2025.
source_title: POWERGRID Integrated Annual Report FY 2024/25

title: Commercial operation of 102 MW plant
description: NEA's operating-projects appendix lists Middle Bhotekoshi (102 MW) commercial operation on 2082.06.20 BS; the MD report states it entered commercial operation in FY 2025/26. (BS date converted to AD; canonical-lookup)
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2025/26 (A Year in Review)

title: GLOF-induced flash flood halted generation
description: A GLOF-induced flash flood on 8 July 2025 (24 Asar 2082) damaged headworks civil and hydro-mechanical structures and inundated the powerhouse MIV and turbine floors; generation was halted.
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2025/26 (A Year in Review)

title: Unit 1 resumed generation after flood restoration
description: After about five months of restoration, partial generation from the first unit resumed on 20 Mangsir 2082. (BS date converted to AD; canonical-lookup)
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2025/26 (A Year in Review)

title: Unit 2 resumed generation
description: The second unit resumed generation on 10 Poush 2082. (BS date converted to AD; canonical-lookup)
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2025/26 (A Year in Review)

title: Unit 3 resumed generation; full rehabilitation still pending
description: The third unit resumed generation on 31 Baisakh 2083; NEA states full restoration and rehabilitation is planned within FY 2083/84. (BS date converted to AD; canonical-lookup)
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2025/26 (A Year in Review)

title: Forest clearance and public-land use approvals received
description: The Ministry of Forests and Environment approvals were received on 2082/11/19 BS after an eight-month work suspension; this is a regulatory milestone, not construction progress. (BS date converted to AD; canonical-lookup)
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2025/26 (A Year in Review)

title: Construction resumed after eight-month suspension
description: Construction activities resumed on 8 March 2026 following the forest-clearance and land-use approvals.
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2025/26 (A Year in Review)

title: Cumulative physical progress 21.68% at FY 2082/83 end
description: Cumulative physical progress reached 21.68% and financial progress 25.90%; Lot-2 (electromechanical and transmission) was awarded and mobilised during the year.
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2025/26 (A Year in Review)

title: Lot-1 98.65% and Lot-2 about 94% complete
description: Civil and hydro-mechanical works (Lot-1) were 98.65% complete and electromechanical works (Lot-2) about 94% complete, with overall completion targeted for August 2026.
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2025/26 (A Year in Review)

title: Overall progress about 70% after EPC re-tendering
description: After termination of the original EPC contract and re-tendering in two lots (Lot-2 EM/HM contract signed Mangsir 2082 on the third attempt), overall physical and financial progress was about 70% by FY 2082/83 end.
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2025/26 (A Year in Review)

title: Revised cost NPR 11,466 million; RCOD extension applied to 1 Sep 2027
description: ICRA Nepal recorded a revised project cost of ~NPR 11,466 million at ~70:30 debt-equity, completion expected by mid-July 2028, and an RCOD extension application to 1 September 2027 against an expired RCOD of 30 June 2024.
source_title: ICRA Nepal rationale: Trishuli Jal Vidhyut Company Ltd BLR surveillance (Jul 2026)

title: About 78% complete across three packages
description: NEA's MD report states the 140 MW Tanahu project is about 78% complete across its three construction packages.
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2025/26 (A Year in Review)

title: Civil construction progressing after pre-construction milestones
description: Licensing, environmental approval, financing and land acquisition are complete and civil construction is progressing on Upper Modi A and Upper Modi.
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2025/26 (A Year in Review)

title: IEE approved for 81 km 400 kV evacuation line
description: The Initial Environmental Examination for the 81 km 400 kV line from the main powerhouse to Dhalkebar was approved on 27 November 2025.
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2025/26 (A Year in Review)

title: Physical market-sounding events in Europe
description: Market-sounding events were held in Switzerland, Austria, Belgium and Luxembourg from 25 February to 6 March 2026 and in Kathmandu on 27 April 2026; bidding documents are under final review.
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2025/26 (A Year in Review)

title: ESIA report disclosed on ADB website
description: The Environmental and Social Impact Assessment report was disclosed on the ADB website on 30 April 2026; other safeguard plans were being finalised.
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2025/26 (A Year in Review)

title: Indicative term sheet with HIDCL-led lender consortium
description: CJCL entered an indicative term sheet with HIDCL (lead) and Sanima Bank (co-lead); credit rating and due-diligence appraisal are underway. Generation licence, EIA approval and grid connection agreement are already in place.
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2025/26 (A Year in Review)

title: Access road, tunnel, camp and hydraulic-model works progressing
description: UAHEL reported preparatory infrastructure works and design review progressing; this does not establish main-works construction start.
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2025/26 (A Year in Review)

title: Hetauda-Dhalkebar 400 kV construction resumed
description: NEA states the decade-long issue in constructing the Hetauda-Dhalkebar 400 kV line has been resolved and works have resumed, with completion expected in a few months.
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2025/26 (A Year in Review)

title: 13th JWG/JSC approved interim 220 kV operation
description: The 13th JWG/JSC meeting (14-15 July 2026) approved operating the Butwal-Gorakhpur line at 220 kV until 400 kV commissioning, restricting interim import to 130 MW and export to 200 MW.
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2025/26 (A Year in Review)

title: Combined Muzaffarpur and Sitamarhi line capacity approved
description: The 13th JWG/JSC meeting approved a combined capacity of 1,650 MW export and 1,400 MW import for the Dhalkebar-Muzaffarpur and Dhalkebar-Sitamarhi 400 kV lines.
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2025/26 (A Year in Review)

title: Nepal replied to China's Letter of Exchange
description: NEA reports Nepal notified its agreement through a Letter of Reply in May 2026 (day not stated) to China's Letter of Exchange on implementation; detailed engineering is planned for FY 2026/27 and construction from FY 2028/29.
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2025/26 (A Year in Review)

title: FY 2082/83 delivered energy 2,388.02 GWh
description: UTKHPP delivered 2,388.02 GWh to NEA in FY 2082/83, up from 1,527.77 GWh in FY 2081/82.
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2025/26 (A Year in Review)

title: Rolwaling Khola works suspended
description: NEA reports all Rolwaling Khola (RKHEP) works have been suspended since 10 July 2025; the 456 MW plant itself remains operating.
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2025/26 (A Year in Review)

title: Headrace tunnel heading excavation completed
description: SJVN's important-events list records HRT heading and surge-shaft lining work on 23 May 2025.
source_title: SJVN Arun-III HEP project page (important events)

title: Units 1-3 pit-free achieved
description: SJVN records Unit-1, Unit-2 and Unit-3 pit-free status on 8 December 2025.
source_title: SJVN Arun-III HEP project page (important events)

title: Headrace tunnel benching completed
description: SJVN records HRT benching on 30 April 2026.
source_title: SJVN Arun-III HEP project page (important events)

title: Draft tube gates erected
description: SJVN records erection of draft tube gates on 22 May 2026.
source_title: SJVN Arun-III HEP project page (important events)

title: Financial progress ~24%; full debt financial closure
description: ICRA Nepal reports ~24% financial progress as of mid-July 2026 (vs ~8% in June 2025) and financial closure for the entire budgeted debt (~59% of NPR 51,105 million cost); RCOD June 2028.
source_title: ICRA Nepal rationale: Tamor Energy Pvt. Ltd. BLR surveillance (Sep 2026)

title: Bank facilities rating reaffirmed; RCOD 10 June 2029
description: CARE Ratings Nepal reaffirmed the long-term bank facilities rating of the 106 MW PROR project financed at 69:31 debt-equity, with RCOD of 10 June 2029.
source_title: CARE Ratings Nepal press release: Jagdulla Hydropower Company Ltd (Jul 2026)

title: Required commercial operation date reached before commissioning
description: CARE Ratings Nepal records the RCOD of 29 June 2026 and notes the company has grounds for further RCOD extension until NEA completes the evacuation substation.
source_title: CARE Ratings Nepal press release: Nasa Hydropower Ltd (May 2026)

title: Commercial operation under contingency evacuation plan
description: CARE Ratings Nepal records commercial operation of the 73 MW plant from 5 May 2024 under a contingency evacuation plan.
source_title: CARE Ratings Nepal press release: Sanima Middle Tamor Hydropower Ltd (Mar 2026)

title: Commercial operation of 54 MW plant
description: CARE Ratings Nepal records commercial operation from 22 May 2023, with evacuation still through a contingency arrangement.
source_title: CARE Ratings Nepal press release: Peoples Hydropower Company Ltd (Dec 2025)

title: FY26 generation 98.77 MU (~70% of contract)
description: CARE Ratings Nepal reports FY26 generation of 98.77 MU, about 70% of the 141.74 MU contracted energy, after 86%, 65% and 69% in FY23-FY25.
source_title: CARE Ratings Nepal press release: Arun Kabeli Power Ltd (Oct 2026)

title: Commercial operation of 77 MW Likhu-1
description: CARE Ratings Nepal records commercial operation from 1 April 2024; FY24 PLF was ~35.68% of contracted energy over 109 operating days.
source_title: CARE Ratings Nepal press release: Pan Himalaya Energy Ltd (Mar 2025)

title: Commercial operation of 55 MW Likhu-2
description: CARE Ratings Nepal records commercial operation from 31 July 2023 (RCOD extended to the same date, preserving all tariff escalations).
source_title: CARE Ratings Nepal press release: Global Hydropower Associate Ltd (Mar 2025)

title: Commercial operation of Nilgiri Khola II
description: ICRA Nepal records commercial operation of N2 since 6 April 2024 (N1 since 5 August 2024).
source_title: ICRA Nepal rationale: Nilgiri Khola Hydro Power Co. BLR surveillance (Aug 2025)

title: Commercial operation of 44 MW Super Madi
description: ICRA Nepal records commissioning on 10 April 2023, about five months after RCOD, within the window preserving all eight tariff escalations.
source_title: ICRA Nepal rationale: Super Madi Hydropower Ltd issuer/BLR surveillance (Apr 2026)

title: Commercial operation of 23.5 MW Solu (Upper Solu)
description: ICRA Nepal records business operation from 23 March 2020.
source_title: ICRA Nepal rationale: Upper Solu Hydro Electric Co. ratings withdrawal (Aug 2025)

title: AIIB project summary updated
description: AIIB's updated Project Summary Information lists total cost USD 647.4 million (USD 453.2 million debt, USD 194.2 million equity), an AIIB senior loan of up to USD 90 million, and a 35-year BOOT structure.
source_title: AIIB Project Summary Information P000085 Upper Trishuli-1 (updated Oct 2025)

title: Butwal Power Company to acquire Statkraft and Eviny stakes in HPL
description: ShareSansar reports BPC acquiring Statkraft's and Eviny's shareholdings in Himal Power Limited, which owns Khimti-I.
source_title: ShareSansar: Butwal Power Company to acquire major shares in Himal Power Limited

title: Commercial operation of 42.5 MW Sanjen
description: NEA reports SHEP commercial operation from 16 December 2024 (Poush 01, 2081).
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2024/25

title: Supplementary syndicated loan agreement signed
description: NEA reports (by FY 2081/82 end; signing date not stated, event dated to the report) financial closure via a supplementary syndicated loan agreement for UMAHEP with NMB Bank, HIDCL and Sanima Bank.
source_title: NEA Annual Report FY 2024/25
